evidence: The composition of the fabricated GeO2 film was analyzed by Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) using an ULVAC-PHI 700Xi spectrometer (Kanagawa, Japan). Film roughness and morphology were analyzed by atomic force microscopy (AFM) using a NanoScope V Scanning Probe Microscope (IA, USA). The crystallinity of the grown films was investigated by grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) using a Bruker AXS high-resolution X-ray diffractomer. The thermal properties of the prepared precursors were analyzed by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA; TA Model Q600) and differential scanning calorimeter analysis (DSC; TA Instruments Model Q-10, DE, USA).
